_comment: Public replications gallery. One entry per independently contributed energy.json. Entries are added by the maintainer after a submission arrives as a GitHub issue on hongping-zh/ecocompute-mlcube; moderation checks schema and format only, never the numbers. Keep this list empty rather than seeded: a gallery of examples would be indistinguishable from fabricated replications.

_entry_schema.handle: contributor handle as they want to be credited, e.g. @someone
_entry_schema.arch: one of turing | ada | ampere | blackwell | hopper
_entry_schema.n: independent trials, integer >= 1 (declared by the contributor; the container's iterations are not trials)
_entry_schema.report: URL to the raw energy.json, or null
_entry_schema.link: repo / blog / paper URL, or null
_entry_schema.note: maintainer's one-line reading of the point, or null
